turns.question: What was the median site session duration in minutes between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for median site session duration in minutes, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Site sessions (sessions with a page view, counted on the day of the page view) and Engaged customers (7 days), which I did not query for this period; no freshness statement was returned because no query was run.
